blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Modern video models possess strong visual priors, yet do not natively represent human action in metric 3D space. We present EgoGeneralist, which adapts pretrained video generators to unify action-conditioned egocentric video generation, pose estimation, and joint action-video generation. Our role-adaptive action renderer provides video-native representations for multidirectional action-video learning, making metric motion usable as both a spatial control signal and a recoverable generation target. Cross-stream action-video coupling establishes close correspondence between metric motion and visual dynamics through lightweight adaptation while preserving the pretrained visual prior. Together, these designs establish a generalist framework spanning five action-video tasks. Despite adaptation only on controlled laboratory recordings, EgoGeneralist generalizes to diverse unseen scenes and interactions with effective action control and visual quality, bridging pretrained visual knowledge and metric 3D human motion.
blocks.zh: 现代的视频模型具有很强的视觉前科,但并非本土在度量3D空间中代表人类行动. 我们介绍Ego Generalist,它改造了经过预先训练的视频生成器,以统一以行动为条件的以自我为中心的视频生成器,提出估计,以及联合行动-视频生成器。 我们的角色适应动作渲染器为多方向动作-视频学习提供了视频-内在表现,使量子运动既可以用作空间控制信号,也可以用作可回收的生成目标. 跨流动作-视频耦合通过轻量级的适应,同时保留预先训练的视觉前缘,在度量运动和视觉动态之间建立密切的对应关系. 这些设计共同建立了一个涵盖五个行动视频任务的总体框架。 尽管仅对受控制的实验室录音进行改编,但Ego Generalist对各种不见的场景和互动进行了概括,具有有效的动作控制和视觉质量,连接了预先训练的视觉知识和衡量的3D人类运动.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Modern video generators have acquired strong priors over appearance, motion, and visual interactions [ 38 ] .
These priors make them a promising foundation for egocentric video generation, with applications spanning embodied learning, human–object interaction, and AR/VR [ 26 , 11 , 51 ] .
In egocentric video, what a person sees is shaped jointly by body movement, hand manipulation, and camera motion.
A video generator can imagine these visual experiences, yet does not natively represent what the person does in metric 3D space.
Integrating metric 3D action would connect embodied motion with its visual consequences.
blocks.zh:
现代视频生成器在外观,运动,和视觉互动上获得了强大的前科[38].
这些前科使得它们成为以自我为中心的视频生成的有希望的基础,其应用包括包含学习、人与对象的相互作用以及AR/VR[26、11、51]。
在以自我为中心的视频中,人们看到的是由身体运动,手操和相机运动共同塑造的.
视频生成器可以想象这些视觉体验,然而却不能在本土上代表人物在平面3D空间中的行为.
综合量子三维行动将把所体现运动与其视觉后果联系起来。

blocks.en:
This connection is inherently multidirectional.
Actions guide video generation, video observations provide evidence for recovering motion, and joint generation captures how the two evolve together.
Although often studied separately, these tasks describe different directions of the same action–video relationship.
Recent unified systems connect several of these directions, yet rely on separately parameterized action representations [ 60 , 22 , 37 , 42 ] .
Aligning these representations with video often requires large-scale joint training, undermining reuse of the generative prior [ 42 , 7 , 29 ] .
This raises a central question: can a pretrained video generator become an egocentric action–video generalist, extending its visual prior to metric 3D motion and generalizing broadly?
blocks.zh:
这种联系本质上是多方向的。
动作引导视频生成,视频观测为恢复运动提供证据,联合生成捕捉到两者如何共同演化.
这些任务虽然经常单独研究,但描述了同一个动作-视频关系的不同方向.
最近的统一系统连接了其中的几个方向,但依赖于单独的参数化动作表示 [60, 22, 37, 42].
将这些表述与视频相配合,往往需要大规模的联合培训,破坏基因前的再利用[42,7,29].
这引起了一个中心问题:预先训练的视频生成器能否成为一个自取其利的动作 — — 视频通论者,在公制3D运动之前扩展其视觉并广泛概括?

blocks.en:
To this end, we introduce EgoGeneralist, a video-native framework for unified egocentric action–video learning.
A role-adaptive renderer represents action as video, which the pretrained model can natively consume as a condition or generate as a target. Cross-stream action–video coupling then establishes correspondence through shared attention and target-specific LoRA in the video latent space, without extra input channels or conditioning encoders.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们引入了Ego Generalist,这是统一自我中心行动-视频学习的视频-本土框架。
角色适应渲染器代表了作为视频的动作,被预先训练过的模型可以作为条件在本土消耗或者作为目标生成. 然后通过共享关注和视频潜在空间中针对特定对象的LORA建立通信,不增加输入频道或调制编码器。

blocks.en:
Our framework supports six action–video inference modes across five tasks ( Fig. 1 ).
These capabilities encompass action-conditioned video synthesis, action recovery from video, and joint action–video generation with metric upper-body, hand, and camera motion.
Despite being trained only on controlled laboratory recordings, the adapted video generators generalize to unseen scenes, objects, and interactions.
From text alone, they further synthesize paired metric action and video, offering a new means of action–video data generation.
blocks.zh:
我们的框架支持五项任务的六种行动-视频推论模式(图1)。
这些能力包括有行动条件的视频合成、从视频中恢复动作、以及用公制上体、手和相机运动生成联合行动。
尽管只接受了受控制的实验室录音培训,但经过改造的视频生成器一般化为看不见的场景、物品和互动。
仅从文本来看,它们就进一步合成了组合的参数动作和视频,提供了一种新的动作手段-视频数据生成.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are as follows: • A unified framework for egocentric action–video learning. We formulate action-conditioned video synthesis, metric action recovery, and joint action–video generation as a single video-based problem, coupling visual generation with metric upper-body, hand, and camera motion within a unified framework. • Role-adaptive rendering with cross-stream action–video coupling. We introduce role-adaptive action renderings for spatial control and metric action recovery, coupled with video within the pretrained model’s native latent space through shared attention and target-specific low-rank updates.
This design learns action–video correspondence with less disruption to the visual prior. • Unified capabilities competitive with task-specific experts. Experiments across five evaluation settings show that our framework, adapted only on laboratory recordings, matches or surpasses specialized baselines, while generalizing to in-the-wild action–video generation.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献如下: • 以自我为中心的行动的统一框架-视频学习。 我们将行动带条件的视频合成、计量行动恢复和联合行动-视频生成作为一个单一的视频问题,将视觉生成与计量的上体、手和相机运动结合在一个统一的框架内。 · 角色适应渲染与跨流动作相接。 我们通过共同关注和针对特定目标的低级更新,在预先训练过的模型的原生潜在空间中引入适应作用动作渲染,以进行空间控制和度量动作恢复。
此设计可以学习动作- 视频通信, 并且较少干扰视觉前端 。 • 与具体任务专家竞争的统一能力。 5个评估环境的实验表明,我们的框架仅根据实验室的录音加以调整,匹配或超过专门基线,同时概括为万事万事化的影视生成。

We formulate action-conditioned video synthesis, metric action recovery, and joint action–video generation as a single video-based problem, coupling visual generation with metric upper-body, hand, and camera motion within a unified framework.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Action-Conditioned Ego Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 有行动条件的Ego视频生成

blocks.en:
A central design choice in action-conditioned egocentric video generation is how motion is represented and fused with the denoising network.
Embedding-based methods encode action sequences and inject them into the video model, e.g., through adaptive normalization [ 4 ] , timestep embeddings [ 3 ] , or feature modulation and cross-attention [ 30 ] , with camera motion folded into the same representation [ 30 ] or encoded as camera-ray features [ 51 ] .
Some methods further augment action embeddings with encoded skeleton renderings [ 51 ] or occlusion-aware reference features propagated along hand trajectories [ 56 ] .
Across these designs, motion control still relies on aligning learned conditioning features with the pretrained video features.
blocks.zh:
在动作条件自负式视频生成中,一个中央设计选择是运动如何表现和与去诺网络结合.
基于嵌入的方法将动作序列编码并注入到视频模型中,例如通过适应性正常化[4],时间步嵌入[3],或特征调制和交叉注意[30],相机运动折叠为同一种表示 [30],或被编码为相机-射线特性[51].
一些方法进一步扩充了被编码的骨架渲染[51]或被掩体-意识的参考特征所嵌入的动作. [56].
在整个这些设计中,运动控制仍然依赖于将所学的调制功能与预先训练的视频功能相配合.

blocks.en:
Spatially aligned methods instead render prescribed motion in the image plane, using projected skeletons [ 47 , 9 , 50 , 12 ] or hand-mesh renderings [ 16 ] as explicit spatial guidance.
These renderings, however, are typically coupled to the generator through expanded input channels [ 16 , 12 ] or auxiliary conditioning branches [ 47 ] , which alter the pretrained computation path and can weaken reuse of the visual prior [ 24 , 17 , 8 ] .
Camera control poses a further challenge, since body and hand projections leave viewpoint motion implicit.
Existing approaches usually embed camera motion [ 9 , 51 ] or derive viewpoint-dependent conditions from reconstructed scenes and 3D scene memory [ 16 , 12 , 52 ] , the latter demanding additional geometric reconstruction and scene-state maintenance.
In contrast, our framework provides explicit body and camera control without scene reconstruction or separate camera embeddings.
Moreover, rendered motion in these methods serves only as a condition, whereas ours supports both spatial control and metric action readout within the native latent space of the pretrained video model.
blocks.zh:
空间对接方法反而使图像平面上设定的运动,使用投影骨架[47、9、50、12]或手拍渲染[16]作为明确的空间取向。
然而,这些渲染通常通过扩大的输入通道[16,12]或辅助调理分支[47]与生成器相接,从而改变事先经过训练的计算路径并会削弱视觉先前[24,17,8]的再用.
相机控制构成又一个挑战,因为身体和手部投影会让视线运动隐含.
现有方法通常会嵌入相机运动 [9,51] 或从被重建的场景和3D场景内存中得出视距依赖条件 [16,12,52],后者要求额外的几何重建和场景状态维护.
相比之下,我们的框架提供明确的机身和相机控制,而不进行场景重建或单独的相机嵌入.
此外,这些方法中的运动只是一种条件,而我们既支持空间控制,也支持在经过预先训练的视频模型的原生潜在空间内进行量度动作读取。

blocks.en: 2.2 Egocentric 3D Pose Estimation
blocks.zh: 2.2 以Egocentral 3D Pose估计

blocks.en:
Egocentric 3D pose estimation seeks to recover body and hand motion from first-person observations.
Hand reconstruction has advanced from single-image estimation [ 31 , 33 , 35 ] to video-based methods that exploit temporal cues for pose estimation [ 49 ] and account for camera motion to recover world-space hand trajectories [ 58 , 55 ] .
Extending reconstruction to the body further requires inferring motion from incomplete and distorted observations [ 39 ] .
Prior work addresses this ambiguity through geometric context and learned motion priors.
Specifically, external-view supervision during training, scene geometry, and stereo-temporal observations provide constraints on body configuration [ 44 , 45 , 2 ] .
Learned motion priors also support estimation conditioned on head or camera trajectories [ 20 , 54 , 32 ] .
Modeling correlations between body and hand motion further enables their joint recovery [ 54 , 43 , 19 ] .
More recent work jointly reconstructs human motion, camera trajectories, and scene geometry from monocular egocentric video [ 27 ] .
Unlike these methods, our framework reformulates upper-body, hand, and camera motion recovery as a unified video generation task, jointly recovering metric 3D motion through a pretrained video denoiser.
blocks.zh:
Egocentral 3D平面平面估计试图从第一人称观测中恢复身体和手动.
手部重建已经从单相图估计[31,33,35]发展到利用时间提示来作出估计[49],并用相机运动来恢复世界-空间手部轨迹的以视频为基础的方法[58,55].
将重建扩大到身体还需要从不完整和扭曲的观察中推断出运动[39].
先前的工作通过几何上下文和学到的运动前题来解决这一模糊性。
具体来说,在训练期间的外观监督,场景几何,和立体时态观测,都对身体的配置造成了制约[44,45,2].
学会的运动前科还支持以头部或相机轨迹为条件的估计[20、54、32]。
模拟身体与手动之间的关联进一步使其联合恢复[54、43、19]。
更近期的作品共同从单相机自负心视频中重建出人类运动,相机轨迹,场景几何[27].
与这些方法不同,我们的框架重塑了上体,手,相机运动的恢复,作为统一的视频生成任务,通过经过预先训练的视频denoiser,共同恢复了度量的3D运动.

blocks.en: 2.3 Unified Egocentric Action–Video Learning
blocks.zh: 2.3 统一以Egocentral Action-Video学习

blocks.en:
Unified multimodal diffusion supports multiple prediction directions within a shared model by varying which modalities are observed and generated [ 6 , 18 , 8 ] .
In robotics, this principle has been used to couple video prediction with action inference [ 60 , 22 , 7 ] .
Closely related works extend unified modeling to egocentric interactions, jointly generating video and hand actions [ 37 , 42 ] .
However, they only consider hand motion and rely on action-specific encoders, denoisers, or conditioning networks.
In contrast, our framework jointly models metric upper-body, hand, and camera motion and couples action and video through lightweight adaptation.
By retaining the pretrained backbone and per-stream input structure, we effectively reuse the visual prior and achieve strong generalization.
blocks.zh:
统一的多式传播支持在共同模型内通过不同的方式观测和生成[6、18、8]多种预测方向。
在机器人学中,这一原则被用于将视频预测与动作推论相配 [60, 22, 7].
密切相关的作品将统一的模型扩展至自心互动,联合生成视频和手动动作[37,42].
然而,它们只考虑手动,依靠动作特异性的编码器,denoisers,或调节网络.
相比之下,我们的框架通过轻量级的适应, 共同模拟了测量上身、手和相机运动以及夫妇动作和视频。
通过保留被预先训练的骨干和每流输入结构,我们有效地再用视觉先并实现强通.

blocks.en: 3.2 Role-Adaptive Action Rendering
blocks.zh: 3.2 角色调整行动

blocks.en:
To ease action–video alignment and better leverage the pretrained visual prior, we render action as video.
Action rendering, however, serves two roles.
As a condition, its spatial alignment with the egocentric view yields more direct correspondence with video in the spatially structured latent space.
As a generation target, it must preserve 3D geometry for metric readout, which a single ego-view projection leaves ambiguous ( Sec. C.1 ).
We therefore introduce a role-adaptive action renderer that selects between two video representations according to the role of action.

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
We instantiate our method on the I2V and T2V variants of Wan2.2-A14B [ 38 , 41 ] and use the EgoDex dataset [ 13 ] for training.
EgoDex’s controlled recording environments allow us to assess generalization from visually limited training scenes to more diverse environments.
We train for one epoch on the official EgoDex training split, sampling one 41-frame clip from each episode.
Videos are processed at × 464 832\!\times\!464 resolution, and action renderings are generated on the fly from motion expressed in the clip’s initial camera coordinate frame.
Further implementation details are provided in the supplementary material.

我们在Wan2.2-A14B[38,41]的I2V和T2V变体上即时使用方法,并使用EgoDex数据集[13]进行训练.
EgoDex的受控录制环境使我们能够评估从视觉有限的训练场景到更多样化的环境的概括性。
我们在正式的EgoDex训练中训练一个时代, 从每集抽取一个41帧的片段。
视频在X464 832\!\times\!464分辨率进行处理,从剪辑初始相机坐标框中表达的动作在苍蝇上产生动作渲染.

blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate the three prediction directions introduced in Sec. 3.1 across five evaluation settings.
Quantitative experiments cover action-conditioned video generation with and without an initial image ( Sec. 4.3 ), egocentric pose estimation ( Sec. 4.4 ), and world-action policy ( Sec. 4.5 ).
Finally, we qualitatively examine text-only joint generation ( Sec. 4.5 ).
Prompts displayed in qualitative figures are abbreviated for readability.
blocks.zh:
我们评价第3.1节在五个评价环境中提出的三个预测方向。
定量实验包括有行动条件的视频生成和没有初始图像(第4.3节)、以自我为中心的平面估计(第4.4节)和世界行动政策(第4.5节)。
最后,我们从质量上审查只使用文本的联合生成(第4.5节)。
以定性数字显示的提示缩写为可读性。

blocks.en:
The in-domain test set contains 111 clips randomly sampled from the EgoDex test split, one per activity category to ensure balanced coverage.
For out-of-distribution evaluation, we sample 50 Xperience-10M [ 36 ] clips with valid annotations, spanning diverse scenes and activities in the wild.
For quantitative world-action policy evaluation, we use HOT3D [ 5 ] , which provides the 3D object annotations required for proximity measurement and lies outside our training domain.
We randomly sample 50 initial states with visible hands and reachable targets within 5–30 cm, yielding 99 target-reaching tasks.
Following the camera-normalization principle of Being-H0 [ 26 ] , we rectify Xperience-10M and HOT3D fisheye videos to a fixed target pinhole camera and use the same rectified inputs for all methods.
Details of the benchmark construction are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:

对于分布外评价,我们抽取了50个Xperience-10M [36] 有有效说明的片段,横跨了野外的各种场景和活动.
对于定量的世界行动政策评价,我们使用HOT3D[5],它提供了近距离测量所需的三维对象说明,并位于我们训练领域之外.
我们随机抽取50个初始状态,在5-30厘米以内有可见的手和可达到的目标,产生99个目标范围的任务.
按照Being-H0[26]的相机规范化原则,我们将Xperience-10M和HOT3D鱼眼视频修正为固定目标针孔相机,并对所有方法使用相同的修正输入.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented EgoGeneralist, a unified framework for action-conditioned ego video generation, metric pose estimation, and joint action–video generation.
Role-adaptive rendering and cross-stream coupling connect metric motion with the video generator’s native representation through lightweight adaptation.
Experiments demonstrate effective action control and generalization beyond laboratory training scenes, alongside competitive motion recovery and target-reaching performance.
Text-only joint generation further enables paired synthesis of action and video.
Together, these results establish pretrained video models as a practical foundation for egocentric action–video learning.

我们提出了“Ego Generalist”方案,这是一个统一的框架,用于制作以行动为条件的自负视频、衡量姿态估计和联合行动-视频生成。
角色适应渲染和跨流相接通过轻量级的适应,将量子运动与视频生成器的本土代表相接.
实验展示了有效的动作控制和超越实验室训练场景的通俗化,同时展示了竞争性运动恢复和有目标效果.

这些结果共同建立了预先训练的视频模型,作为以自我为中心的行动-视频学习的实际基础。

blocks.en:
EgoDex’s multi-camera fusion introduces projection mismatches between 3D annotations and images.
These discrepancies can carry over into generated sequences, occasionally affecting action–video alignment.
More accurately aligned training data could reduce these artifacts.
Further, although our method generalizes well, the EgoDex recordings cover a limited range of environments and body motion.
More diverse annotated data, including standing, walking, and outdoor activities, could further extend our framework’s capabilities.

blocks.en: A.1 Posegrid Decoder

blocks.en:
The Posegrid decoder converts latents from the frozen video VAE into metric 3D motion through a shared spatiotemporal encoder and two output branches.
The encoder projects the 16-channel latents to 384 channels and processes them with three residual 3D convolutional blocks.
Features are spatially pooled to a 12 × 16 12\times 16 grid, projected to a temporal sequence, and refined by four residual temporal blocks.
Linear interpolation restores the original frame count.
The two output branches recover positions and rotations for 68 skeletal joints and the camera, all expressed in the initial camera coordinate frame.
We use replicate padding in the convolutional blocks to avoid introducing zero-valued features at sequence boundaries.

blocks.en: B.1 Dataset Construction

blocks.en:

blocks.en:

We finally randomly sample 50 clips from the remaining candidates to cover diverse scene types.

blocks.en:
We construct the world-action policy benchmark from 136 HOT3D Aria recordings with ground-truth annotations.
Candidate initial states are screened at two-second intervals for annotation validity, hand visibility, non-contact initialization, and target reachability, with redundant nearby states excluded.
Eligible targets have reliable geometry and sufficient visibility, lie within 60 cm of the camera, and are 5–30 cm from an operating fingertip.
We randomly sample from the eligible candidates and the final benchmark contains 50 initial states and 99 tasks, each specifying an initial state, target object, and operating hand.
We complete the missing HOT3D body state using EgoDex pose and bone-length statistics, providing an approximate initialization that need not be accurate.

我们随机抽取合格候选人和最终基准包含50个初始状态和99个任务,每个任务都指定初始状态,目标对象,以及操作手.
我们利用EgoDex的姿势和骨长统计来完成缺失的HOT3D体态,提供了不需要准确的近似初始化.

All variants in Tab. 6 use 2,048 training episodes and 1,200 updates at a global batch size of 8, and are evaluated using the same video-generation metrics.

blocks.en:
Using the video-generation training and evaluation settings in Sec. C.1 , we further evaluate the advantages of cross-stream action–video coupling design.
We compare cross-stream coupling with two alternative conditioning strategies: latent channel concatenation , which concatenates action and video latents along the channel dimension, and action embedding , which injects encoded numerical motion through separate cross-attention.
All variants train the active LoRA adapters, together with any added conditioning modules.
Our full configuration outperforms both alternative coupling strategies across all reported metrics on both datasets ( Tab. 6 ), learning more effective action control and video generation within the same short training budget.
Despite using only 0.65% of the full training episodes and limited updates, our method approaches the full-training results on several metrics ( Tab. 1 ), suggesting the potential for data-efficient adaptation through effective reuse of the pretrained video prior.

Figure S7 : Additional HOT3D examples of joint action–video generation and hand-action comparisons.
EgoGeneralist generates smooth hand trajectories that accurately approach the specified objects, whereas the baseline trajectories miss the targets in these examples.
Columns show normalized prediction progress, with visualization conventions following Fig. 5 .
blocks.zh:
图S7:联合行动-视频生成和手动比较的额外HOT3D实例.
Ego Generalist 生成能准确接近指定对象的平滑手轨,而基线轨迹却错过了这些例子中的目标.
列显示正常的预测进展,可视化常规遵循图5。

Figure S8 : Additional text-only joint action–video generation.
Across diverse scenes, generated actions remain well aligned with the overall hand-motion trends in the generated videos.
Each example pairs generated video with decoded action overlays at frames 0, 10, 20, 30, and 40.

图S8:仅限文本的额外联合行动-视频生成.
在不同的场景中,产生的行动仍然与制作的视频的整体手动趋势完全一致。
每个实例对生成的视频都以0,10,20,30和40帧的解码动作覆盖.

Four chunks are generated by conditioning each continuation on the preceding generated final frame.
Alternating rows compare ground truth and generated video over the first and second halves of the sequence.
blocks.zh:

EgoGeneralist generalizes to changes in appearance and environment, opening up further applications of action-conditioned video generation. (a) Two human-to-robot appearance-transfer examples. (b) Ground truth and generated videos in the original scene and edited indoor and outdoor settings.
blocks.zh: 图S11:外观和背景变化。 Ego Generalist对外观和环境变化的概括,开放了附加条件的视频生成的进一步应用. (a) 两个人对机器人外观转让实例。 (b) 在原场景中记录真实情况并制作录像,编辑室内外环境。
